Un système agentique axé sur la rapidité: An agentic system focused on execution speed and privacy
Conçu pour les tâches agentiques au sein: Designed for enterprise agentic tasks, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL aims to accelerate high-volume automated processes spanning multiple days or weeks. According to evaluations conducted by Artificial Analysis, Nvidia's solution clearly outperforms its similarly sized rivals, relegating InclusionAI's Ling 3.0 Flash and DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash to second and third place in benchmark tests.
Bien que la version de base du modèle ne: Although the base version of the model does not directly surpass all proprietary systems on the market, its open architecture enables targeted post-training. In a specific test on health insurance reimbursement queries, fine-tuning the model generated a 44% accuracy gain, exceeding the results recorded by Claude Opus 5. This approach offers organizations the ability to train the tool on their own databases and run it on their own private infrastructure, enhancing customization and data security.
Le lancement comprend également deux mod: The launch also includes two models intended for edge computing, capable of operating offline autonomously. The first, named Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24 GB, targets the execution of local agents with a balanced ratio between speed and capabilities per gigabyte. The second, called Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4 GB, is geared toward voice agents, embedded devices, and interactive characters.
Cette annonce s'inscrit dans un mouvemen: This announcement is part of a trend accelerating open models developed by Western laboratories. This segment, historically marked by the work of Chinese players such as DeepSeek and Moonshot.ai, also records the recent releases of Le Chonk by the French company Mistral and Beam by the firm Reflection AI.
Nemotron 3.5 Super VL intègre cent vingt: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL integrates 120 billion parameters and boasts a speed five times higher than its main competitor according to Artificial Analysis.
Le post-entraînement sur des données spé: Post-training on specialized data achieved a 44% increase in accuracy in the health insurance sector.
Deux déclinaisons Edge de 24 Go et 4 Go: Two Edge variants of 24 GB and 4 GB were introduced for local offline execution.
L'architecture à poids ouverts permet l': The open-weights architecture allows hosting on companies' own infrastructure to optimize data protection.
